description:
About CWILL
 CWILL (pronounced 'quill') is a post-purchase and retention suite built for Shopify brands. Reduce support tickets, recover lost revenue from returns, and turn one-time buyers into loyal fans — with tools purpose-built for every touchpoint that follows the sale.
 About the Role
 CWILL AI SEO & Image Optimizer is our AI-powered SEO and site speed product for cross-border e-commerce and Shopify merchants. It helps merchants improve content quality, indexing, keyword coverage and organic traffic, with more site audits, keyword analysis, content generation, reporting and AI SEO workflows on the way.
 As an R&D Trainee, you'll learn by building real features with a mentor, and grow into an engineer who owns a module independently.
 Product Intro: 
 https://www.cwill.com/products/seo-speed/ 
 Base location required: 
 Cary, NC
 (We are unable to hire in other states; relocation will be required.)
 Hybrid remote working setting
 What You'll Do
 Build AI SEO Features 
 With guidance from your mentor, develop features across site audits, page checks, keyword analysis, content optimization, AI suggestions and reporting
 Break down requirements into technical tasks, then code, integrate, test and release
 Work on API integration between frontend and backend, data processing, business logic and UI improvements
 Own the quality of what you ship
 Process SEO Data and Improve the System 
 Work with page, keyword, meta tag, site structure and indexing data
 Build SEO check rules, scoring logic, optimization suggestions and report metrics
 Help troubleshoot production bugs, data issues and customer-reported problems
 Build AI SEO Capabilities 
 Develop AI generation of titles, meta descriptions, content suggestions and keyword suggestions
 Improve AI output quality, generation speed, user experience and error handling
 Work on prompts, rules, templates and output evaluation
 Collaborate and Deliver 
 Work with product, design, QA, operations and customer success to understand the why behind each feature
 Follow team coding standards, take part in code review, and add documentation and tests
 Share progress, risks and blockers proactively, and join retrospectives after each launch
 Your Growth Path 
 By 3 months: understand the product and its main workflows; complete small features, bug fixes and data tasks with your mentor
 By 6 months: independently own a small module, such as an SEO check, optimization suggestions or a report page
 By 12 months: own a product module or technical area at the level of a junior engineer
 Requirements 
 Requirements 
 Proficiency in Go (Golang) is required. Experience with other languages such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java or PHP is a plus
 Bachelor's or master's degree from a US university, graduating recently or within the last 1–2 years. Any major; Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or related fields preferred
 Solid understanding of web development fundamentals: HTTP, APIs, databases and frontend–backend interaction
 Good coding and debugging skills: you can get to the bottom of a problem and fix it completely
 Strong learner who reads documentation, digs into problems and grows quickly on real projects
 Reliable and detail-oriented; you keep the team updated on progress and issues
 Professional working proficiency in Mandarin Chinese and English (you will work daily with our engineering team in China)
 Software development or SaaS internship experience preferred
 Nice to Have 
 Experience building web apps, SaaS, SEO tools, AI apps, online stores or Shopify apps
 Familiarity with one or more of: PHP, React, Node.js, Next.js, NestJS, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis
 Basic SEO knowledge: keywords, titles, meta descriptions, site structure, indexing and organic traffic
 AI projects such as LLM apps, prompting, RAG, content generation or automated analysis
 Experience with data collection, data cleaning, reporting or web crawlers
 Benefits 
 Starting Pay: 80k - 110k depends on experiences, open to negotiation
 401(k)
 PTO
 Paid Holidays
 Insurance
